review_prompt: Confirm the Trust pathway title, owner, version, issue date and review date.
Decide whether the two classification images are acceptable sources and record their provenance.
Confirm the mild, moderate and severe sodium bands and decimal-value handling.
Confirm the Hypovolaemic, Euvolaemic and Hypervolaemic branch structure.
Confirm the six source-listed cerebral-oedema-associated signs and their branch meaning.
Confirm the initial hypertonic-saline instruction, concentration, volume and route wording.
Confirm the 4-6 mmol/L target and maximum 10 mmol/L correction in 24 hours.
Resolve the undefined 4.0-5.0 mmol/L four-hour response interval.
Supply or approve criteria for high ODS risk and confirm the monitoring branch.
Confirm hourly monitoring until a 4-6 mmol/L increase and then every 4-6 hours.
Confirm cause review, 0.9% sodium chloride volume, duration and emergency add-on placement.
Confirm how SIADH and water intoxication must be established before management selection.
Supply or identify the approved separate SIADH pathway; confirm that no local SIADH treatment is generated.
Confirm senior review, urine dip and underlying-cause wording and whether additional management is required.
Resolve exact equality at 275 and 295 mOsm/kg.
Resolve exact equality at 100 mOsm/kg.
Resolve exact equality at 40 mEq/L and the unstated euvolaemic value at or below 40 mEq/L.
Confirm that all cause outputs are compatible categories rather than diagnoses.
Confirm clinical priority, warnings, terminology, mobile layout and absence of visible internal references.
Record approved, changes requested or rejected; name reviewers and date the decision.
